import base64
import json
from urllib.parse import quote, unquote


def execute(node_id, node_data, context):
    data = json.loads(context.get("player_data") or "{}")
    raw_url = data.get("url") or ""
    encrypt = str(data.get("encrypt") or "0")

    if encrypt == "2" and raw_url:
        raw_url = base64.b64decode(raw_url).decode()
    token = unquote(raw_url) if raw_url else ""

    context["player_token"] = token
    context["player_url"] = "https://player.cycanime.com/?url=" + quote(token, safe="")
